verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries inside the product. Its official MCP server lets AI agents query telemetry, investigate issues, and work with Boards, Triggers, SLOs and Canvas from prompts such as "Investigate latency in the api-gateway service." A community report describes an LLM agent using Honeycomb's MCP server during real incidents. Missing for 10: in-product natural-language operation beyond query generation (configuration and admin through Query Assistant), and independent hands-on corroboration that the natural-language features are reliable.
